description: Create the order for a cart and return a payment_url (Stripe). The customer opens it, enters the delivery address and pays there (card, 3-D Secure). Nothing is charged before the customer confirms on that page. Ask the customer for their e-mail address first.

email.description: Customer e-mail for the order confirmation

phone.description: Customer mobile number (DE/AT/CH), only needed for send_payment_link_by_sms / _by_whatsapp

send_payment_link_by_email.description: Only if the customer asked for it: also send the payment link to the e-mail address

send_payment_link_by_sms.description: Only if the customer asked for it: also send the payment link by SMS to phone. Paying still happens on the payment page.

send_payment_link_by_whatsapp.description: Only if the customer asked for it: also send the payment link by WhatsApp to phone.

name: checkout
